follow-up time: January 2000 - December 2007 (audit) and July 2008 - October 2008 (pilot study)
exposure: subcutaneous fentanyl for pain relief during labor
nitrous oxide and oxygen prior to subcutaneous fentanyl
cohort: Pregnant women with uncomplicated pregnancies and term births (37-42 weeks gestation)
finding: While fentanyl use was associated with longer labor duration, likely due to higher induction rates, neonatal outcomes, length of hospital stay, and breastfeeding rates were comparable between groups.
